explication: Angular is a TypeScript/JavaScript platform for building web applications. The repository tree also includes Angular.dev, an interactive documentation site, and Angular DevTools. A common user journey is learning Angular, exploring API references, then experimenting with code in the embedded editor. The graph includes documented platform capabilities and visible supporting subsystems; sampled runtime code is limited to animations and service-worker cache storage, so framework-wide execution paths are not inferred.
